content: .{@-तर्पणम्@} .²1 an oblation to the Manes. .²2 the act of throwing water out of the right hand (as at the time of ablutions) as an offering to the Manes or deceased ancestors; नित्यं स्नात्वा शुचिः कुर्याद् देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् <ls>Ms. 2. 176</ls>. .²3 sesamum. .²4 gifts given at Srāddhas or funeral rites. .²5 the part of the hand between the thumb and the fore-finger (sacred to the Manes).
